source.label: Product opportunities: core relevance + hardware frontier
filters: Core: inputRelevance >= 4 OR aiInput >= 4.
Frontier: isHardware AND breakthrough >= 4 AND wonder >= 4.
New observations Oct 12–19 plus explicitly labeled ongoing, prelaunch and user-curated projects.
caveats: All six 1–5 scores are editorial judgments, not measured performance.
Opportunity scores range from 20 to 100 under the requested 1–5 inputs; weights are 6/4/4/3/2/1. Heat is 5% of total weight.
Software can enter through core relevance but is excluded from the hardware-frontier KPI.
Commercial and source-available products are labeled separately; inclusion does not imply OSI/OSHWA-compliant licensing.

evidenceFlow.title: Collection
evidenceFlow.detail: Checked on 2026-10-19. Web open/search of https://github.com/SvenKunkka/open-source-weekly-radar and the official project URLs in the rows. Search-index observations are explicitly labeled; not all origins return live data.

metricDefinitions.label: Opportunity score
metricDefinitions.definition: inputRelevance*6 + aiInput*4 + breakthrough*4 + potential*3 + wonder*2 + heat. Each dimension is 1–5.

metricDefinitions.label: Core relevance
metricDefinitions.definition: Direct relation to input devices and desktop workflows; 1 low, 5 very high.

metricDefinitions.label: AI input
metricDefinitions.definition: Role of AI in voice, vision, gestures, context or Agent input; 1 low, 5 very high.

metricDefinitions.label: Hardware frontier
metricDefinitions.definition: Hardware only; breakthrough and novelty both >=4. Scores reflect editorial potential, not lab validation.

methods.code: score = inputRelevance*6 + aiInput*4 + breakthrough*4 + potential*3 + wonder*2 + heat; core = inputRelevance >= 4 || aiInput >= 4; frontier = isHardware && breakthrough >= 4 && wonder >= 4; selectionPath = core && frontier ? "Both / 双重命中" : core ? "Core / 核心相关" : "Frontier / 前沿破格"; sort by score descending; assign priority from 1.
